theme: cpu work shard NPROC STRIDE MONOTONIC elapsed budget partition

tests.name: nproc
tests.cmd: SYS NPROC → workers default + META key:val

weaknesses.title: Identifier end is END keyword — LET end corrupts control flow
weaknesses.detail: LET end = count - 1 parsed as LET then END closing the IF, leaving '= count - 1' as unknown form and breaking later writes. Agents naming loop bounds end silently wreck programs.

weaknesses.title: Bare mid-arg STRIDE offset var is unknown form
weaknesses.detail: SYS STRIDE workers shard_id work fails; must use SYS STRIDE workers OFF shard_id work. Same class as canary board OFF footgun.
weaknesses.repro: SYS STRIDE 4 shard_id bag → unknown form shard_id

weaknesses.title: RANGE inclusive both ends — off-by-one vs half-open intuition
weaknesses.detail: RANGE 0 16 yields 17 ids. Seed N needs RANGE 0 (N-1). Easy to over-seed worker bags.

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN is path join not string concat
weaknesses.detail: JOIN "workers:" "4" → workers:/4. No simple strcat; REPLACEALL templates required for key:val stamps.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses bag newlines
weaknesses.detail: Multi-line SHARD/WORK look glued in JSON plates; agents mis-count fields without LINES.

weaknesses.title: WRITE omit trailing NL — wc -l undercounts WORK
weaknesses.detail: 16 ids 0..15 show wc -l 15 without final NL.

weaknesses.title: LOOKUP default sep is colon not equals
weaknesses.detail: workers=4 needs LOOKUP sep "="; key:val works with default. Mixed plate conventions confuse agents.
weaknesses.repro: LOOKUP bag workers with = lines fails bare

workarounds: Never name vars end/if/then; use rend/last_i
Always STRIDE step OFF off bag form for var offsets
RANGE 0 (N-1) for N items; document inclusive
REPLACEALL templates for key:val; not JOIN
LINES after PRINT_JSON for bag counts
language_gaps: Reserved-word diagnostic on LET end (not silent END)
STRIDE mid-arg numeric/var without OFF keyword
RANGE half-open mode or exclusive end flag
SYS STRCAT / CAT for non-path concat
issues_faced: LET end keyword collision nearly broke whole board
STRIDE bare mid-arg fixed via OFF
